freeze.revision_policy: Do not overwrite a frozen v1 file. Any content change requires a new versioned filename and a new manifest.

experimental_model_output_use.statement: No GlyphProbe model inference, activation, logit, generated-text, metric, run-summary, or tokenizer-outcome data were used to author, select, filter, rank, or revise these records.

authoring_and_selection_rule.method: Text-only manual authoring followed by deterministic structural validation.
authoring_and_selection_rule.compatibility_reference: The existing prestage target groups and record schemas were consulted only for group coverage, schema compatibility, and exact-duplicate exclusion. Existing source wrapper templates were consulted only for exact-template exclusion.
target_constraints: Use exactly six prespecified primary groups: continuation, factual, reasoning, procedural, classification, and planning.
Include exactly eight distinct English prompts per group in each bank.
Give each prompt one compact, self-contained task with no glyph or emoji condition.
Use bank-specific IDs and exclude exact prompt duplicates within a bank, between the two frozen banks, and against the prestage target file.
Do not inspect tokenizer results or experimental model outputs while constructing or validating the banks.
source_wrapper_constraints: Include exactly 16 distinct templates with exactly one literal {emoji} placeholder each.
Use m2w01 through m2w16 ID prefixes in file order.
Exclude exact template duplicates within the new bank and against the existing source wrapper file.
Do not inspect tokenizer results or experimental model outputs while constructing or validating the wrapper bank.

banks.purpose: One-shot confirmation of the prespecified tokenization-matched fingerprint endpoint and candidate gate after all matching and analysis rules are frozen.
banks.prohibited_use: Do not use this bank to develop matched controls, tune thresholds, debug an adapter, or explore causal intervention sites.

banks.purpose: Final held-out confirmation of a causal intervention selected without access to outcomes from this bank.
banks.prohibited_use: Do not use this bank for matched-control design, threshold tuning, candidate-layer selection, strength selection, intervention-site selection, or implementation debugging.

banks.purpose: Independent source contexts for Milestone 2 direction estimation, separate from the exploratory source wrappers.
banks.prohibited_use: Do not alter or filter these wrappers after inspecting tokenizer or experimental outcomes; create a new version instead.
